build_equivariant_layer_norm: build an EquivariantLayerNormArray module to normalize equivariant features of shape N, sphere_basis, C per degree L
build_spherical_harmonics_layer_norm: build an EquivariantLayerNormArraySphericalHarmonics module to normalize L=0 separately and group all L>0 components together
build_rms_norm_spherical_harmonics_v2: build an EquivariantRMSNormArraySphericalHarmonicsV2 module to apply RMS normalization across all spherical harmonic degrees with optional centering
build_degree_layer_scale: build an EquivariantDegreeLayerScale module to scale equivariant features by degree with a configurable scale factor
create_normalization_layer_factory: create a normalization layer using get_normalization_layer with norm_type layer_norm, layer_norm_sh, or rms_norm_sh
